name: Windham Parks & Recreation Summer Day Camp
description_short: A 7-week town-run summer day camp for grades 1-8, held at one of four camp locations. Campers do field trips, special events, arts and crafts, and sports and games.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: This page is the department's general overview of youth and family programs, not a dedicated camp page. Its details are an undated 'sample' of offerings, and current info is on rec.us/windham and the separate 'Summer Day Camp' page.
The page doesn't name a season year, so season_year is left blank. Registration is described as opening 'the last Monday in March and runs through late May' each year.
The same page lists other summer programs (Tennis Camp in July, Paddling Camp in August, Summer Track & Field, Summer Enrichment). These are separate programs and are not part of this listing.
The page shows two phone numbers: 207-892-1905 for Parks & Rec and 207-892-1907 for the Town office. The Parks & Rec number was recorded.
